mapper.insert: INSERT INTO en_enrollment (enrollment_id, user_id, mst_code, order_id, status, period_start, period_end) VALUES (#{enrollmentId}, #{userId}, #{mstCode}, #{orderId}, 'ACTIVE', #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'ACTIVE', period_start = VALUES(period_start), period_end = VALUES(period_end), order_id = VALUES(order_id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM en_enrollment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC
